description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp inal class Middleware, which provides static methods for creating various middleware functions used in HTTP request handling, such as cookies management, error handling, request history tracking, request/response logging, redirects, retries, request/response transformations, and other request/response lifecycle hooks.

classes.name: Middleware
classes.description: Provides static methods to create middleware functions for Guzzle HTTP client, including cookies handling, error handling, request history, logging, redirects, retries, request/response transformation, and request lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Creates middleware that adds cookies to requests using a CookieJarInterface instance set in the options array.

methods.name: httpErrors
methods.description: Creates middleware that throws exceptions on 4xx or 5xx HTTP responses if the 'http_errors' option is true.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Creates middleware that records request and response data into a container (array or ArrayAccess) for history tracking.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Creates middleware that invokes optional before and after callbacks around a request.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates redirect middleware handling HTTP redirects.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Creates middleware that retries requests based on a decider callback with optional delay between retries.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Creates middleware for logging requests, responses, and errors with a specified logger and formatter.

methods.name: prepareBody
methods.description: Creates middleware that sets default headers related to content type, length, and transfer encoding.

methods.name: mapRequest
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation function to requests before passing along.

methods.name: mapResponse
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation function to responses after request completion.
